cyberArkApplications.title: CyberArk Applications
cyberArkApplications.hint: The application IDs (AppIDs) in Self-Hosted CyberArk, read from PVWA each night, with how each authenticates and how many accounts and Safes it can retrieve from (as a Safe member with Retrieve accounts, or through a Vault group). Hash values aren't stored.
cyberArkApplications.empty: No CyberArk Applications. They are read by the nightly Self-Hosted Direct pull; the PVWA user needs the Audit Users authorization.

decomAccounts.title: Accounts Flagged for Deletion
decomAccounts.hint: Accounts in a {safeLink}, or whose own name matches the {pattern} (Admin > Global Application Configuration). {notDeleted} marks accounts still active in CyberArk; {alsoIn} lists other safes holding an account with the same username and address.
decomAccounts.whatNext: BlueTrack only reports these. Delete them in CyberArk; this report updates after the next data load.
decomAccounts.emptyFiltered: No accounts match the search and filters.
decomAccounts.empty: No accounts are flagged for deletion.

decomSafes.title: Safes Flagged for Deletion
decomSafes.hint: Safes whose name matches the {pattern} (Admin > Global Application Configuration), typically a prefix or suffix such as {prefix} or {suffix} added while CyberArk's retention policy keeps the safe, or while its accounts move to another safe. Accounts still in these safes are on {accountsLink}.
decomSafes.whatNext: BlueTrack only reports these. Delete or move them in CyberArk; this report updates after the next data load.
decomSafes.empty: No safes are flagged for deletion. If you expected some, check the safe decommission pattern.

discoveredAccounts.emptyNone: No discovered accounts yet. They appear after a discovery data feed has run.
discoveredAccounts.emptyFiltered: No discovered accounts match the current filters.
discoveredAccounts.title: Discovered Accounts
discoveredAccounts.hint: Real Active Directory accounts not yet onboarded into CyberArk, found by matching AD group membership against the Access Group inventory -- risk-scored the same way an onboarded account would be. Click a row's account name to see which Access Groups it matched. Accept moves an account into onboarding tracking (visible immediately in the Account Progress list); Dismiss clears a false positive or an already-onboarded match without creating a tracked account. Neither talks to CyberArk directly -- actual Vault onboarding still happens there.
discoveredAccounts.acceptConfirm: Accept "{account}" ({domain}) into onboarding tracking? This creates a real tracked account, visible immediately in the Account Progress list at the Discovered stage.
discoveredAccounts.dismissConfirm: Dismiss "{account}" ({domain})? It is removed from this list as a false positive or an account that is already onboarded.
discoveredAccounts.sortHelp: Click a column to sort by it; shift-click another column to add it as a secondary sort key.
discoveredAccounts.ownerAmbiguous: Owner ambiguous: more than one account shares the employee ID
discoveredAccounts.overrideHint: Kept across discovery runs until cleared. Leave both as they are to follow the rules on Admin > Account Classification.

kpiSummary.title: KPI Summary
kpiSummary.inScopeVsAll: Accounts In Scope vs. All Accounts
kpiSummary.onboardedVsInScope: Accounts Onboarded vs. Accounts In Scope
kpiSummary.compliantVsManaged: Accounts Managed vs. Compliance (% of Managed that are Compliant)
kpiSummary.defAll: Every inventory account that is not deleted, excluding feed accounts linked to a CyberArk account.
kpiSummary.defInScope: All Accounts except those with the status Risk Accepted / Excluded.
kpiSummary.defOnboarded: In Scope accounts at Blueprint stage 3 or later.
kpiSummary.defManaged: In Scope accounts at Blueprint stage 4 or later.
kpiSummary.defCompliant: Accounts at the final stage (5) with the status Complete.
kpiSummary.listNote: Each count opens the Accounts list showing those accounts. The Accounts list shows accounts that have progress tracking, so an In Scope or All Accounts count can be higher than the list if some accounts have none yet.

overdueAtRiskWorklist.title: Overdue / At-Risk Worklist
overdueAtRiskWorklist.empty: No accounts are past their target remediation date.

possibleAccountMatches.title: Possible Account Matches
possibleAccountMatches.hint: Accounts from other systems (account inventory data feeds) that may be the same as a CyberArk account, but didn't match it exactly: the user name is the same, and the addresses agree by host name or DNS. {link} treats them as one account, as an exact match would: the other system's account is hidden and moves to Onboarded to Vault. {dismiss} means they're different accounts; the pair isn't suggested again.
possibleAccountMatches.linkConfirm: Link {user} on {address} ({source}) to CyberArk account "{account}"? It will be hidden from Account Progress and counted as the CyberArk account.
possibleAccountMatches.dismissConfirm: Dismiss {user} on {address} ({source}) as a different account from CyberArk account "{account}"? The pair is not suggested again.

reconciliationReviewQueue.title: Reconciliation Review Queue
reconciliationReviewQueue.hint: Unconfirmed matches between a Self-Hosted account and a Privilege Cloud account, listed for review. This page is read-only: it has no confirm or reject buttons. To link accounts from other systems (data feeds) to CyberArk accounts, use {possibleMatches}.

riskExceptionSodReport.title: Risk Exception Segregation of Duties
riskExceptionSodReport.hint: Cases where the same person both approved a Risk Exception and later linked it to an account's progress record. Shown here regardless of whether "Enforce segregation of duties on Risk Exception approval" is currently enabled on Global Application Configuration.

riskScoreReport.emptyNone: No accounts have a risk score yet.
riskScoreReport.title: Risk Score
riskScoreReport.hint: EffectiveRiskScore is the Override (if set) or otherwise the Computed score. Click a row's Account name to see the real Targets/Access Groups behind its score.
riskScoreReport.noContributors: No contributing Targets or Access Groups found.
riskScoreReport.sortHelp: Click a column to sort by it; shift-click another column to add it as a secondary sort key.

stageStatusFunnelSummary.title: Stage/Status Funnel Summary
stageStatusFunnelSummary.showCell: Show the {count} accounts in {stage} with status {status}

trends.rangeBackwards: From must not be after To. The report below is for the last valid range.
trends.title: Trends
trends.intro: How accounts have moved over time, from the nightly progress snapshot. % complete uses the KPI Summary's rule: accounts at the final stage with status Complete, out of the accounts in scope (not Risk Accepted / Excluded).
trends.empty: No progress history in this range. Snapshots are taken by the nightly job; choose an earlier range, or check back after it has run.
trends.emptyFiltered: No progress history in this range for this Application or Safe. Snapshots are taken by the nightly job; choose an earlier range, or check back after it has run.
trends.stagesChartLabel: Accounts by stage, stacked bars, {range}. The numbers are in the data table that follows.
trends.percentChartLabel: Percent complete, a line, {range}. The numbers are in the data table that follows.
trends.risksChartLabel: Accounts by risk level, stacked bars, {range}. The numbers are in the data table that follows.

unresolvedEntitlementMembers.title: Unresolved Entitlement Members
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.hint: These Safe members have an ID in the Entitlements export that matches no user or group in the Users and Groups exports. The nightly load links a member to the one user or group with exactly the same name (ignoring case); the rest are listed here, typically built-in CyberArk cloud roles or identities from CyberArk Identity or Entra ID.
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.hintResolve: Resolve links a member to the right user or group, or marks it as an external or cloud role. It applies to every safe the member is on, and is kept through the nightly load. Undo removes it.
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.loadFailed: Could not load unresolved entitlement members: {error}
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.undoConfirm: Undo the resolution of {name}? It will be matched by ID or name again, or listed as unresolved.
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.resolveAppliesTo: Member ID {id}, on {count} safe shown. | Member ID {id}, on {count} safes shown.
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.linkUser: The same person as this user
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.linkGroup: The same group as this group
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.externalChoice: External / cloud role (not a user or group in the exports)
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.externalChoiceSelfHosted: External (not a Vault user or group)
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.chooseUser: Choose the user to link this member to.
unresolvedEntitlementMembers.chooseGroup: Choose the group to link this member to.

cpmHealth.title: CPM Health
cpmHealth.hint: Accounts whose CPM status is failure: the CPM couldn't verify, change or reconcile them at its last try, so their passwords may not match the Vault. Longest failing first. The CpmHealth notification emails the newly failing ones each day.
cpmHealth.empty: No account's CPM status is failure.
